name: io.github.bruceonline2026/feedwatch
title: FeedWatch
description: Monitor RSS/Atom/JSON feeds; alerts on new items AND edits to existing ones, with field-level diffs.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token，即你的 FeedWatch API Key（在 https://api.tiici.com/ 申请）。也可用 x-api-key 头。

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.title: Create a change monitor
tools.description: Create a change monitor on an RSS, Atom, or JSON Feed URL. Reports new items and - unlike most tools - edits to existing items, with field-level diffs.

url.description: The RSS/Atom/JSON Feed URL to monitor

keywords.description: Only alert when title or content matches one of these keywords

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.title: List change monitors
tools.description: List all change monitors for this account with their status and next check time.

tools.name: check_feed
tools.title: Check a feed once
tools.description: Fetch a feed immediately and return detected changes (added / modified / removed) with field-level diffs. Does not require a monitor to exist.
